detail.title: 一种撑磁瓦夹具
detail.abstract: The invention discloses a magnetic shoe supporting clamp, and particularly relates to the field of motor magnetic shoe clamping tools. The magnetic shoe can be quickly attached to the motor shell by arranging the spring ejector rod, the cushion block, the ejector block and the push block, the structure is simple and compact, the impact on the beat is small, the operation is smooth, the working efficiency is high, and the requirements of a full-automatic assembly line can be basically met.
